class.name: VehicleEngineData
class.brief_description: Configuration data for a vehicle's engine characteristics.
class.description: VehicleEngineData is a [Resource] that defines the performance characteristics of a vehicle engine, including its torque curve, idle and redline RPM ranges, rotational inertia, and maximum torque output. Used by [Vehicle] to configure its internal [VehicleEngine] simulation.

method.name: set_torque_curve
method.description: Sets the torque curve [Curve] resource. The curve maps engine RPM (normalized 0-1) to torque output (normalized 0-1).

method.name: set_idle_rpm
method.description: Sets the engine idle RPM. At closed throttle, an unloaded engine cancels configured engine drag at this target and supplies recovery torque below it.

method.name: set_redline_rpm
method.description: Sets the engine redline RPM. The maximum RPM the engine can reach.

method.name: set_inertia
method.description: Sets the rotational inertia of the engine in kg·m². Higher values make the engine spool up and slow down more slowly.

method.name: get_inertia
method.description: Returns the rotational inertia of the engine in kg·m².

method.name: set_max_torque
method.description: Sets the maximum engine torque output in Nm. The actual torque at any given RPM is determined by the torque curve multiplied by this value.

method.name: get_max_torque
method.description: Returns the maximum engine torque output in Nm.

members.member: Torque curve mapping normalized RPM (0-1) to normalized torque (0-1). The actual torque is this multiplied by [member max_torque].
